'''Ascercia''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the military of [[House of Thul]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

In [[3643 BBY]], he and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Virne]] went on a mission to install a prototype Imperial sensor array until their party was was attacked by [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] and the Imperials that carried the sensors were killed and cocooned to the hive. They tasked an Imperial individual to help recover the sensors. Their commanding officer was [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Pharoth]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=general|Bugs and Bombs|Alderaan (Imp)}}</ref>
